names.name: Avocado scale
names.explanation: Our original catalog used Avocado scale, but the verified name for Froggattiella penicillata is Penicillate scale. The old label is retained here so you can find the correction; it should not be used to identify this species.

names.name: Gill fluke
names.explanation: Gill fluke is a broad, misleading label for this species. Haplorchis pumilio larvae commonly encyst around fish fin bases; gill-focused descriptions may refer to other flukes. Use the scientific name to distinguish them.

names.name: Leaf-curling plum aphid
names.explanation: Leaf-curling plum aphid refers to Brachycaudus helichrysi, not Dysaphis crithmi. This entry concerns the aphid associated with rock samphire; we retain the old catalog label only to explain the mismatch.

names.name: Pea aphid
names.explanation: Pea aphid commonly refers to Acyrthosiphon pisum. This profile concerns Acyrthosiphon primulae, associated with primroses. The shared genus does not make them the same species.

names.name: Chinese yam
names.explanation: Chinese yam usually refers to Dioscorea polystachya. Older North American references often used Dioscorea oppositifolia for that different species. The catalog label is under review; records cannot be reassigned from the name alone.

dioscorea-oppositifolia.warning: Chinese yam usually refers to Dioscorea polystachya. Older North American references often used Dioscorea oppositifolia for that different species. The catalog label is under review; records cannot be reassigned from the name alone.

names.name: Citrus canker
names.explanation: Citrus canker is associated with Xanthomonas citri pv. citri, historically called Xanthomonas campestris pv. citri. The additional words identify a particular bacterial group; the unqualified species name is not equivalent. This catalog label is under review.

xanthomonas-campestris.warning: Citrus canker is associated with Xanthomonas citri pv. citri, historically called Xanthomonas campestris pv. citri. The additional words identify a particular bacterial group; the unqualified species name is not equivalent. This catalog label is under review.

names.name: Banana leaf spot
names.explanation: This disease label is not a precise identification of Pestalotiopsis disseminata. Reports describe several hosts, and older identifications can be uncertain. We retain the catalog label with this qualification while the underlying evidence is reviewed.

pestalotiopsis-disseminata.warning: This disease label is not a precise identification of Pestalotiopsis disseminata. Reports describe several hosts, and older identifications can be uncertain. We retain the catalog label with this qualification while the underlying evidence is reviewed.

names.name: Corm dry rot
names.explanation: The evidence reviewed so far does not establish this disease label for a confirmed modern identification of Rigidoporus vinctus. Historical uses of the scientific name include several different fungi. The label and original records remain under review.

rigidoporus-vinctus.warning: The evidence reviewed so far does not establish this disease label for a confirmed modern identification of Rigidoporus vinctus. Historical uses of the scientific name include several different fungi. The label and original records remain under review.

names.name: Euphorbia esula
names.explanation: Older North American references often applied Euphorbia esula to the widespread leafy spurge now treated as Euphorbia virgata. The true Euphorbia esula is a different species. We include the older usage to help you find this profile, not to combine their records.
